description: MUSCLE 3.8.1551's multiple alignment (Edgar 2004, NAR 32:1792; muscle -in x.fa -out y.fa), ported step by step from the program's source: letters upper-cased, gaps / white space dropped, letters outside the alphabet replaced by the wildcard (X protein, N nucleotide), a leading M of a protein aligned as X and restored (methionine hack); first guide tree from a k-mer distance (distance1: kmer6_6 over the six MAFFT residue groups for proteins, kmer4_6 for nucleotides, kmer20_3, kmer20_4, kbit20_3, pwkimura, pwscoredist) clustered by UPGMB (0.1 x average + 0.9 x minimum linkage; cluster1: upgma, upgmamin, upgmamax, neighborjoining) and rooted (root1 pseudo / midlongestspan / minavgleafdist), ClustalW tree weights (weight1: none, henikoff, henikoffpb, gsc, clustalw, threeway), profile-profile dynamic programming with position-specific gap open / close penalties and half-open terminal gaps (termGaps half / full / ext), the log-expectation score (VTML200 likelihood ratios, center -0.52, gap open -2.9) for proteins or MUSCLE's nucleotide sum-of-pairs score (BLASTZ matrix, gap open -400) for DNA / RNA (scoreModel sp = PAM200, sv = VTML240 for proteins, a matrix file replaces the matrix of the SP score); maxIters >= 2 rebuilds the tree from the distances of the draft (distance2 pctidkimura / pctidlog / edit / scoredist, cluster2, root2) and realigns only the subtrees whose leaf sets changed (maxTrees); maxIters >= 3 adds maxIters - 2 rounds of restricted-partition refinement (every guide-tree edge splits the sequences in two, the two profiles are re-aligned and kept when the objective score objScore sp / dp / xp / ps / spf / spm improves, inside the blocks between anchor columns unless anchors = false). The program's own default is maxIters 8; the default here is 2. Options accepted but without effect, because the 3.8.1551 source compiles them out: diags / diags1 / diags2 / diagLength / diagBreak / diagMargin, hydro / hydroFactor / tomHydro, gapOpen2 / gapExtend2 / gapAmbig; maxMb / maxHours (resource limits). useTree = a rooted binary Newick tree with edge lengths whose labels are the names (skips the tree refinement); clusterOnly / computeWeights stop early. Rows are returned in input order (treeOrder = the order muscle writes) with the files the program can write (tree1, tree2, distance matrices, weights). totalScore is the natural affine sum of pairs (BLOSUM62 10 / 0.2 for proteins, EDNAFULL 10 / 0.5 for nucleotides), not MUSCLE's objective. VERIFICATION: maxIters 1 and 2 with the option set of the first Docker round (le / sp / sv, gapOpen / gapExtend / center, distance1 kmer6_6, cluster1 / cluster2 upgma*, sueff, maxTrees 0) equal the MUSCLE 3.8.1551 binary built from the same source on 420 / 420 user-run sets (rows and output order). Everything else (maxIters >= 3, objScore, weights, the other distances, neighborjoining and roots, anchors, termGaps, brenner, useTree, the tree / distance / weight files) is verified against the same binary on 630 further user-run sets (docs/Validation/review-2026-09/handoff/A1-10c-muscle-r2): rows in the written order, files and the program's refusals equal; the user matrix (matrix) is verified for proteins with a '*' column (the file without it and nucleotides: round 3).

sequences.description: Sequences to align (at least one, none empty): letters, '-', '.' and white space only.

type.description: 'auto' (default; MUSCLE's guess: nucleotide when >= 95 % of the first 100 residues are A, C, G, T, U or N), 'protein', 'dna' or 'rna' (MUSCLE -seqtype).

maxIters.description: MUSCLE -maxiters (at least 1): 1 = progressive draft, 2 (default) = plus tree refinement, 3 and above = plus restricted-partition refinement iterations (the program's default is 8).

scoreModel.description: Profile-profile score (-le / -sp / -sv / -spn): 'default' (LE for proteins, SPN for nucleotides), 'le', 'sp' (PAM200), 'sv' (VTML240), 'spn'. A score of the wrong alphabet is replaced like the program does (SPN for nucleotides, LE for proteins).

gapOpen.description: MUSCLE -gapopen (a negative score; default -2.9 LE, -1439 SP, -300 SV, -400 SPN DNA, -420 RNA).

distance1.description: MUSCLE -distance1: 'default' (kmer6_6 protein, kmer4_6 nucleotide), 'kmer6_6', 'kmer4_6' (nucleotides only), 'kmer20_3', 'kmer20_4', 'kbit20_3', 'pwkimura', 'pwscoredist' (protein only). kmer20_3 / kmer20_4 / kbit20_3 need sequences of at least 4 residues (the program reads outside its buffer for shorter ones).

sueff.description: MUSCLE -sueff (default 0.1): weight of the average linkage in UPGMB.

maxTrees.description: MUSCLE -maxtrees (default 1): 0 switches the tree refinement of iteration 2 off; more than 1 repeats it only for a weighting other than ClustalW.

treeOrder.description: true: rows in the order muscle writes them (depth-first leaf order of the final guide tree, -group) instead of the input order.

distance2.description: MUSCLE -distance2 (distance of the aligned pairs of iteration 2): 'default' (pctidkimura), 'pctidkimura', 'pctidlog', 'edit', 'scoredist' (protein only).

root1.description: MUSCLE -root1: 'pseudo' (default: the root of the clustering), 'midlongestspan' or 'minavgleafdist'.

weight1.description: MUSCLE -weight1 (sequence weights of the progressive stage): 'clustalw' (default), 'none', 'henikoff', 'henikoffpb', 'gsc', 'threeway'.

weight2.description: MUSCLE -weight2 (sequence weights of the refinement): same values as weight1.

objScore.description: MUSCLE -objscore (refinement objective): 'spm' (default: xp up to 100 sequences, spf above), 'sp', 'dp', 'xp', 'ps' (LE score only), 'spf'.

anchors.description: MUSCLE -anchors (true, default) / -noanchors (false): refine inside the blocks between anchor columns.

brenner.description: MUSCLE -brenner: build the root alignment by aligning every sequence to the root profile.

diags1.description: MUSCLE -diags1 (no effect: compiled out of 3.8.1551; -diags sets diags1 and diags2).

matrix.description: MUSCLE -matrix: the text of a score matrix file (NCBI format) replacing the matrix of the SP score; proteins only.

useTree.description: MUSCLE -usetree: a rooted binary Newick tree with edge lengths, leaf labels = names; skips the first tree and the tree refinement.

names.description: FASTA labels of the sequences (default s0, s1, ...): the leaf names of useTree and of the returned trees.

clusterOnly.description: MUSCLE -clusteronly with -tree1: return only the first guide tree (tree1), no alignment.

computeWeights.description: MUSCLE -computeweights: stop after the progressive alignment and return the weights file instead of an alignment.

stable.description: MUSCLE -stable: the 3.8.1551 program refuses it ("-stable not supported in this version of muscle"), so true is rejected; treeOrder = false (default) already returns the rows in input order.

alignedSequences.description: The aligned rows of the MSA (input order; the order MUSCLE writes with treeOrder). Empty with computeWeights (the program then writes only the weights).

consensus.description: Majority-vote consensus of the aligned rows (gaps vote; a residue beats a gap on ties).

totalScore.description: Natural affine sum-of-pairs score of the alignment (BLOSUM62 10 / 0.2 for proteins, EDNAFULL 10 / 0.5 for nucleotides; MUSCLE itself reports no such score), rounded.

names.description: FASTA labels of the rows (input order; the names parameter, default s0, s1, ...).

outputOrder.description: Indices of the input rows in the order the program writes them (treeOrder).

tree1.description: The first guide tree in the program's -tree1 text format, or null.

tree2.description: The tree of iteration 2 (-tree2), or null.

distanceMatrix1.description: The first distance matrix (-distmx1), or null.

distanceMatrix2.description: The second distance matrix (-distmx2), or null.

errors.message: sequence is empty or contains a character other than a letter, '-', '.' or white space

type must be auto, protein, dna or rna; maxIters must be at least 1; scoreModel / distance1 / distance2 / cluster1 / cluster2 / root1 / root2 / weight1 / weight2 / objScore / termGaps must be a known name; scoreModel and distance1 must suit the alphabet; options the program refuses (stable, ...) are reported as errors
